lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I'm Jennifer, the manager of the Ark Child Protection Center.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Do you have a minute?
Of course.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Thank you, I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: We are a nonprofit organization that helps child victims of domestic violence, as well as those without homes.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: However, one of our children went missing today.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Can you help us with the search?
You... lost a child?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: This happens sometimes: children choose to run away.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Typically we have location detectors that make it quite simple to track them down.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: However, the last location shows up as the surface.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If the child went up to the surface, our hands are tied.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: We, therefore, registered her as missing, and are now asking for your help.
Why would children run away from a protection center?
Why do you have the children wearing location detectors?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Many of them are teenagers, and thus are rather rebellious.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Some of the children also get mixed up with the wrong crowd.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: It is a protective measure.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Children without any family can be easily led astray.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: There are many people out there who specifically target vulnerable children.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If a child is lost up on the surface, there is no way we can guarantee their safety.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: AFD 62.3

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: This is her last registered location.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If you find the child alive, please bring her back safely.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If you find her dead, bring her back regardless.
Why bring back the body?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: For the funeral.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I fully realize, of course, that you may find nothing at all.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I'm hoping you can help us here.
I'll do what I can.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Thank you.
